subject: Native workstation dispatch and execution receipt integrity
audit_findings: Calendar cooldown and four-worker cap were removed in source; live behavior not yet independently verified.
Dispatch job currently requires push or workflow_dispatch, and scheduled hourly event remains inspection-only.
read_runs fetches all enabled worker histories before dispatch; a single GitHub API error can prevent unrelated eligible workers from launching.
Dispatch acceptance does not prove a native worker completed; viewer must use source-owned receipts.
